name: P07 — diagnose why the frozen walk is not moving the boy

steps.note: D1. is the field even updating on __DQ.advance? sample the LIVE player over real time first

steps.eval: (async()=>{const a=__DQ.state().player;__DQ.hold('up');const path=[];for(let i=0;i<10;i++){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));const s=__DQ.state().player;path.push([+s.x.toFixed(2),+s.z.toFixed(2),+s.speed.toFixed(2)]);}__DQ.release('up');return JSON.stringify({mode:'LIVE rAF, hold up',start:[+a.x.toFixed(2),+a.z.toFixed(2)],path,walked:+Math.hypot(path[9][0]-path[0][0],path[9][1]-path[0][1]).toFixed(2),maxSpeed:Math.max(...path.map(v=>v[2]))});})()

steps.note: D2. the same, but on the FROZEN clock via __DQ.advance — sample the LIVE player object, not Field.world().player.p

steps.eval: (async()=>{const {Field}=await import('/src/world/field.js');__DQ.freeze(true);const w=Field.world();const a=__DQ.state().player;__DQ.hold('up');const path=[];for(let i=0;i<10;i++){__DQ.advance(16.6667);const s=__DQ.state().player;const pp=w&&w.player&&w.player.p;path.push([+s.x.toFixed(2),+s.z.toFixed(2),+s.speed.toFixed(2),pp?+pp.x.toFixed(2):null,pp?+pp.speed.toFixed(2):null]);}__DQ.release('up');__DQ.freeze(false);return JSON.stringify({mode:'FROZEN advance x10',start:[+a.x.toFixed(2),+a.z.toFixed(2)],path,walked:+Math.hypot(path[9][0]-path[0][0],path[9][1]-path[0][1]).toFixed(2),fieldPlayerKeys:w&&w.player?Object.keys(w.player):null});})()
